cases.prompt: Pick up the Orbit task assigned to you in this session's execution envelope and implement it; the acceptance criteria are in the task record.
cases.expected: Loads the orbit skill, reads `references/task-execution-steps.md`, and reads the task with `orbit tool run orbit.task.show --input '{"id":"<task-id>"}'` (or MCP `orbit_task_show`) before editing.

cases.prompt: Start an `orbit run auto` drain over the backlog for the next 8 hours and tell me why run jrun-20261120-0412-a1 failed.
cases.expected: Does not load orbit; loads orbit-orchestrate, which covers `orbit run` dispatch, drains and failed `jrun-*` runs.

cases.prompt: Install Orbit on this new Linux box, set up the sweep clock and register the MCP server for Claude.
cases.expected: Does not load orbit; loads orbit-setup, which covers installation, the scheduler and MCP configuration.

cases.prompt: File an Orbit task: `orbit task list --origin automation` returns tasks of every origin. Don't start it.
cases.expected: Reads `references/task-authoring-contract.md` and `references/task-authoring-create.md`, then calls `orbit.task.add` once with a title, a description naming the observed behaviour, testable acceptance criteria, `context_files` selectors for the files the fix will touch and an `origin`. Reads the returned ID from the response (`fields: ["id"]`) instead of inventing one, and neither promotes nor dispatches the task.

cases.prompt: A task must run only on a host with a GPU and not before Monday 09:00 UTC. Which fields do I set, and how?
cases.expected: Reads `references/task-fields-placement.md`; answers with `requires_labels: ["gpu"]` (all labels required, checked against known serving hosts) and `not_before` as an RFC 3339 instant with offset, set through `orbit.task.update`.
